theme.en: Memory and Packaging Set AI's Pace
theme.zh: 存储与封装决定AI扩张节奏

dek.en: Nvidia tests leaner Rubin Ultra memory configurations while TSMC reports mature yields on selected CoWoS products. Capital is following the bottlenecks, from Sony's Japan investment to Meta's reuse of DDR4 through CXL.
dek.zh: Nvidia测试更精简的Rubin Ultra存储配置，台积电则披露部分CoWoS产品已达到成熟良率。资本与系统设计正追随瓶颈移动，从Sony在日本的投资，到Meta借助CXL复用DDR4。

title.en: AI & Accelerators
title.zh: AI与加速器

title.en: AMD Centers Its Next Growth Phase on Rack-Scale AI
title.zh: AMD将机架级AI置于下一阶段增长核心

summary.en: AMD CEO Lisa Su laid out a full-stack AI strategy spanning GPUs, CPUs, networking, software, and rack-scale systems for agentic workloads. The framing matters because AMD is competing for the architecture of the entire AI rack, where system integration and software can be as decisive as accelerator specifications.
summary.zh: AMD CEO苏姿丰提出覆盖GPU、CPU、网络、软件与机架级系统的全栈AI战略，重点面向智能体工作负载。这一定位意味着AMD争夺的不只是加速器份额，而是整套AI机架架构；系统集成与软件的重要性正接近单颗芯片规格。

title.en: Nebius Sets Out a Rapid Path to 1 GW of AI Capacity
title.zh: Nebius规划快速扩至1 GW AI算力容量

summary.en: GPU cloud provider Nebius is pursuing a rapid expansion toward 1 GW of powered capacity and expects to use multiple financing routes to fund it. The plan is another measure of how quickly accelerator demand is translating into power, construction, and balance-sheet requirements rather than chip orders alone.
summary.zh: GPU云服务商Nebius计划快速扩张至1 GW供电容量，并准备通过多种融资方式支撑建设。该计划再次表明，加速器需求正迅速转化为电力、基础设施与资产负债表压力，而不只是芯片采购订单。

title.en: Foundry & Manufacturing
title.zh: 晶圆代工与制造

title.en: Sony-TSMC Deal Lifts Overseas Investment in Japan Chipmaking to $37 Billion
title.zh: Sony与台积电交易将日本芯片业海外投资推至370亿美元

summary.en: A Sony-TSMC agreement brings total overseas investment in Japan's chipmaking sector to $37 billion, according to Nikkei Asia. The total shows how Japan is pairing domestic industrial policy with foreign capital and customer commitments to rebuild manufacturing depth.
summary.zh: 据Nikkei Asia报道，Sony与台积电达成交易后，日本芯片制造领域吸引的海外投资总额达到370亿美元。这一规模显示，日本正把国内产业政策、海外资本与客户承诺结合起来，重建半导体制造纵深。

title.en: TSMC Reports 98% Yield on Selected CoWoS AI Packages
title.zh: 台积电称部分CoWoS AI封装良率达98%

summary.en: TSMC says selected AI products using a 5.5-reticle-size CoWoS implementation have reached 98% packaging yield. The company also points to a 14-reticle-size CoWoS roadmap for 2029, underscoring that larger packages—not only leading-edge lithography—are becoming central to accelerator scaling.
summary.zh: 台积电表示，采用5.5倍光罩尺寸CoWoS方案的部分AI产品，封装良率已达到98%。公司还提出到2029年扩展至14倍光罩尺寸的路线图，说明加速器扩展越来越依赖更大封装，而不只是先进光刻制程。

title.en: Memory
title.zh: 存储

title.en: Nvidia Tests Rubin Ultra With as Little as 192 GB of HBM
title.zh: Nvidia测试最低192 GB HBM的Rubin Ultra配置

summary.en: Nvidia is reportedly testing lower-memory Rubin Ultra designs, including configurations with 192 GB and a move back to HBM4, as memory supply tightens. These are tests rather than a final product decision, but they show that HBM availability can reach far enough upstream to reshape accelerator configurations.
summary.zh: 据报道，在存储供应趋紧之际，Nvidia正在测试更低容量的Rubin Ultra设计，其中包括192 GB配置以及回退至HBM4的方案。这些仍是测试而非最终产品决定，但已表明HBM供应足以向上游传导，直接改变加速器配置。

title.en: Meta Uses CXL and Old DDR4 to Cut Server Count 25%
title.zh: Meta借助CXL复用DDR4，将服务器数量减少25%

summary.en: Meta cut the server count for a workload by 25% by pooling and reusing older DDR4 memory through CXL. The result gives CXL a concrete utilization case, though mismatched DIMMs, power overhead, and telemetry complexity make the approach harder to reproduce outside hyperscale fleets.
summary.zh: Meta通过CXL池化并复用旧DDR4，使某项工作负载所需的服务器数量减少25%。这一结果为CXL提供了具体的资源利用案例，但DIMM规格混杂、额外功耗与遥测复杂度，会让非超大规模运营商更难复制。

title.en: Equipment & Materials
title.zh: 设备与材料

title.en: Korean TC Bonder Rivals Split on Profitability
title.zh: 韩国TC Bonder厂商盈利表现分化

summary.en: Hanmi Semiconductor is defending profitability while rival Hanwha Semitek faces financial strain in Korea's TC bonder market. The divergence is a reminder that strong HBM packaging demand does not translate uniformly into margins, particularly as suppliers invest to qualify tools and expand capacity.
summary.zh: 在韩国TC Bonder市场，Hanmi Semiconductor维持盈利能力，而竞争对手Hanwha Semitek面临财务压力。这种分化说明，旺盛的HBM封装需求不会自动转化为一致的利润率，尤其是在供应商仍需投入设备验证与扩产的阶段。

title.en: Earnings & Markets
title.zh: 财报与市场

title.en: Valens Raises Its 2026 Revenue Outlook
title.zh: Valens上调2026年营收展望

summary.en: Valens Semiconductor raised its 2026 revenue outlook, sending its shares higher. The revision improves demand visibility for the chip supplier and matters more than the immediate stock move because guidance resets expectations for the remaining quarters.
summary.zh: Valens Semiconductor上调2026年营收展望，推动股价上涨。相较于短期市场反应，业绩指引的调整更重要，因为它提高了需求能见度，并重新设定市场对余下季度的预期。

title.en: Challengers & New Silicon
title.zh: 新势力与新硅

title.en: Cerebras Core Revenue Jumps 103% in Q2
title.zh: Cerebras第二季度核心营收增长103%

summary.en: Cerebras reported a 103% year-over-year increase in core revenue for the second quarter. The growth is a meaningful commercialization signal for wafer-scale computing, although one quarter of expansion does not by itself establish the durability or breadth of customer demand.
summary.zh: Cerebras报告第二季度核心营收同比增长103%。这一增速为晶圆级计算的商业化提供了实质信号，但单季扩张仍不足以证明客户需求具备长期持续性与足够广度。

title.en: Tenstorrent Posts GCC Patches for Its Ascalon XG Core
title.zh: Tenstorrent为Ascalon XG核心提交GCC补丁

summary.en: Tenstorrent posted GCC compiler patches for its Ascalon XG processor core. Upstream compiler work is not proof of a shipping product, but it is a necessary step toward a usable software ecosystem and gives developers an earlier view of the core's support requirements.
summary.zh: Tenstorrent为其Ascalon XG处理器核心提交了GCC编译器补丁。上游编译器工作并不等同于产品已经出货，但它是构建可用软件生态的必要步骤，也让开发者更早看到该核心的支持需求。

theme.zh: 实测硬件让神经形态计算落地

dek.en: This week's strongest work moves beyond model-level claims into fabricated circuits, open implementation flows, and measured accelerator tradeoffs. The caveats remain visible: several demonstrations are small, workload-specific, or supported by simulation beyond the initial hardware proof.
dek.zh: 本周较强的工作不再停留于模型层面，而是进入已制造电路、开放实现流程与实测加速器权衡。局限也很清楚：多项演示规模仍小、负载较窄，或在初步硬件验证之外仍依赖仿真。

title.en: Devices & Process
title.zh: 器件与工艺

title.en: PbS Colloidal Quantum-Dot Imagers From Devices to CMOS Integration
title.zh: 从单器件到CMOS集成的PbS胶体量子点成像器

papers.authors: X. Hong, S. Zhang, R. Han, et al.

summary.en: This review maps PbS colloidal quantum-dot imagers from band-structure engineering and defect passivation through flexible arrays and monolithic integration with CMOS readout circuits. Size-tunable bandgaps and solution processing could reduce the cost and integration complexity of visible-to-NIR imaging compared with conventional III-V approaches. It is a synthesis of prior results rather than a new measured array, so the value lies in its cross-layer comparison and remaining-manufacturability agenda.
summary.zh: 这篇综述梳理了PbS胶体量子点成像器从能带工程、缺陷钝化，到柔性阵列及与CMOS读出电路单片集成的发展路径。可调带隙与溶液加工有望相较传统III-V方案降低可见光至近红外成像的成本与集成复杂度。该文是既有成果的综合而非新的实测阵列，其价值主要在于跨层比较以及对剩余制造问题的归纳。

title.en: Circuits & Architecture
title.zh: 电路与架构

title.en: High-Gain Readout for Low-Charge Semiconductor Detectors
title.zh: 面向低电荷半导体探测器的高增益读出电路

papers.authors: D. Zhang, K. Ma, J. Zhang, et al.

summary.en: A three-stage SiGe:C-BJT and LTC6431 preamplifier board delivers 115.27 mV ns/fC charge gain across a 0.5-25 fC input range and 34.0-594.3 MHz bandwidth. Measurements with LGAD, PIN, and 3D silicon detectors reach timing resolutions of 36.41 ps, 76.10 ps, and 39.40 ps, respectively. The board is experimentally validated, but it is a discrete readout implementation rather than a monolithic front end.
summary.zh: 这块三级前置放大板采用SiGe:C BJT与LTC6431，在0.5-25 fC输入范围内实现115.27 mV ns/fC电荷增益，带宽为34.0-594.3 MHz。搭配LGAD、PIN与3D硅探测器时，实测时间分辨率分别达到36.41 ps、76.10 ps与39.40 ps。该方案经过实验验证，但仍是分立式读出实现，并非单片集成前端。

title.en: Noise-Reconfigurable ECG Amplifier With 142.8-GOhm Input Impedance
title.zh: 输入阻抗142.8 GOhm的噪声可重构ECG放大器

summary.en: This chopper-stabilized ECG analog front end combines time-division multiplexing with new impedance-boosting and DC-servo loops to reach 142.8 GOhm input impedance. The ASIC can trade channel count against input-referred noise by reconfiguring among four-, two-, and one-channel modes. The design targets electrode-offset and leakage problems that often dominate wearable biopotential interfaces, with measured silicon reported in JSSC.
summary.zh: 这款斩波稳定ECG模拟前端结合时分复用、新型阻抗提升环路与DC伺服环路，实现142.8 GOhm输入阻抗。ASIC可在4通道、2通道与1通道模式间重构，以通道数换取更低的输入参考噪声。设计针对可穿戴生物电接口中常见的电极失调与漏电问题，JSSC论文给出了实测芯片结果。

title.en: AI Accelerators & Compute-in-Memory
title.zh: AI加速器与存算一体

title.en: A Memristive Neuron That Learns on Chip
title.zh: 可在芯片上学习的忆阻神经元

papers.authors: N. Jimenez Olalla, A. Long Ching Ip, M. Baumann, et al.

summary.en: A physical memristor-and-op-amp neuron implements a biologically inspired local learning rule and learns XOR, AND, and OR in a small network. Moving adaptation into the circuit addresses a core limitation of neuromorphic systems that still depend on offline software training. The hardware proof is limited to elementary logic; the compressed-MNIST scaling result comes from SPICE rather than a larger fabricated network.
summary.zh: 一个由忆阻器与运算放大器构成的物理神经元实现了受生物机制启发的局部学习规则，并在小型网络中学会XOR、AND与OR。把适应过程放入电路，可直接触及当前神经形态系统仍依赖离线软件训练的核心限制。硬件验证仅覆盖基础逻辑，压缩MNIST的扩展结果仍来自SPICE仿真，而非更大规模的已制造网络。

title.en: A Client-Side CKKS Accelerator With Dynamic Twiddle Generation
title.zh: 采用动态旋转因子生成的客户端CKKS加速器

summary.en: This accelerator targets the less-studied client side of CKKS homomorphic encryption, unifying NTT and FFT multiplication while generating twiddle factors dynamically instead of storing large tables. Evaluations on a TSMC 28 nm ASIC and Xilinx UltraScale+ FPGA show more than 40% lower area or gate count and a 1.2x end-to-end speedup against representative hardware baselines. The gains are practical but moderate at system level, making the memory and area reductions as important as raw latency.
summary.zh: 该加速器面向研究较少的CKKS同态加密客户端，将NTT与FFT乘法统一，并动态生成旋转因子，从而避免存储大型常量表。在TSMC 28 nm ASIC与Xilinx UltraScale+ FPGA上的评估显示，相较代表性硬件基线，面积或门数降低超过40%，端到端速度提升1.2倍。系统级速度增益较为温和，因此存储与面积节省与延迟改善同样重要。

title.en: SYNtzulA Open Hardware for Near-Sensor SNN Inference
title.zh: 用于近传感器SNN推理的SYNtzulA开放硬件

papers.authors: L. Martis, G. Leone, L. Raffo, et al.
papers.venue: IEEE Transactions on Computer-Aided Design of Integrated Circuits and Systems

summary.en: SYNtzulA integrates a RISC-V soft core and sparse SNN accelerator in a 6.8 mm2 SoC built with the open IHP-SG13G2 130 nm PDK and OpenROAD flow. The chip runs at up to 125 MHz, reaches 2 GSOP/s, and reports 36.5 pJ per synaptic operation. Its older node and modest throughput limit direct comparison with commercial neuromorphic processors, but silicon from a fully open flow makes the platform unusually reproducible.
summary.zh: SYNtzulA在6.8 mm2 SoC中集成RISC-V软核与稀疏SNN加速器，采用开放的IHP-SG13G2 130 nm PDK和OpenROAD流程实现。芯片最高运行于125 MHz，达到2 GSOP/s，单次突触操作能耗为36.5 pJ。较老制程与有限吞吐量使其难以直接对标商用神经形态处理器，但完全开放流程产出的实测芯片具备少见的可复现性。

title.en: Time-Multiplexed FPGA SNN Accelerator With Pipelined Readout
title.zh: 采用流水线读出的时分复用FPGA SNN加速器

summary.en: A time-multiplexed spike feeder, localized weight memories, and pipelined argmax readout raise an Artix-7 SNN accelerator's maximum clock from 13.3 MHz to 167 MHz. The measured implementation processes an image in 82 microseconds using a 784-64-10 network. The large frequency gain addresses a real routing bottleneck, but MNIST and the small topology leave efficiency on modern workloads unresolved.
summary.zh: 通过时分复用脉冲输入、本地化权重存储与流水线argmax读出，这款Artix-7 SNN加速器的最高频率从13.3 MHz提升至167 MHz。实测实现采用784-64-10网络，单张图像处理延迟为82微秒。频率提升解决了真实的布线关键路径，但MNIST与小型网络拓扑仍不足以说明其在现代工作负载上的效率。

title.en: EDA & Design Tools
title.zh: EDA与设计工具

title.en: Open, Silicon-Verified Asynchronous Periphery for Neuromorphic Chips
title.zh: 面向神经形态芯片的开放式实硅验证异步外围电路

papers.authors: H. Greatorex, M. Cotteret, M. Mastella, et al.

summary.en: This work releases reusable asynchronous peripheral circuits for mixed-signal neuromorphic processors using ACT, quasi-delay-insensitive design, and dual-rail encoding. The library is validated from behavioral models through fabricated-silicon timing measurements, addressing a practical block that many research groups currently redesign from scratch. Its impact will depend on portability across processes and interfaces, but silicon verification makes it more useful than a template-only release.
summary.zh: 该工作发布了一套可复用的混合信号神经形态处理器异步外围电路，采用ACT、准延迟无关设计与双轨编码。其验证覆盖行为模型到已制造芯片的时序测量，针对许多研究团队目前需要重复设计的实际障碍。该库的影响力仍取决于跨制程与接口的可移植性，但实硅验证使其价值高于仅提供模板的开源项目。
